data.one_liner: A cohesive shadcn/ui ecosystem for Flutter with components, theming, and zero Material dependency.
data.what_it_does: Provides over 84 UI components and design tokens built on the shadcn/ui design system for Flutter applications across mobile, web, and desktop. It runs on package:flutter/widgets.dart alone without importing Material or Cupertino, while offering optional companion packages for interop.
use_when: You want to build an application using the shadcn/ui design system in Flutter.
You want a standalone UI kit that does not depend on Material or Cupertino out of the box.
avoid_when: You are strictly committed to the standard Material Design guidelines without custom styling.
You want a minimal widget set and do not need a complete UI ecosystem.
strengths: Large component library with over 84 widgets.
Standalone ecosystem with no hard dependency on material_ui or cupertino_ui.
First-class support across Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
weaknesses: Requires companion packages (shadcn_flutter_material or shadcn_flutter_cupertino) if mixing with standard Material or Cupertino widgets.
Translations have not yet been fully checked by native speakers.
data.setup_notes: Add shadcn_flutter to pubspec.yaml. Optionally add shadcn_flutter_material or shadcn_flutter_cupertino for interop with Material or Cupertino widgets.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Google's standard Material Design system instead of shadcn/ui.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want native Apple iOS-style components.
